name: minikin-skills
description: A personal collection of Agent Skills for Claude Code

plugins.name: bulletproof-rust-web
plugins.description: Architecture and production patterns for Rust web services built with Axum, Tokio, SQLx, and Tower. Layering, domain modeling, error handling, database, HTTP, auth, testing, observability, async pitfalls, plus checklists and project CLAUDE.md templates.

plugins.name: human-writing
plugins.description: Technical prose that reads as written by an engineer, not generated: typography rules, generated-voice tells with prefer-over rewrites, a Markdown checker, a PostToolUse hook that hands back em dashes, curly quotes and ellipsis characters after every Markdown write, and a PreToolUse hook that checks commit messages and gh PR, issue and release text before they are published.
